description: M8 A8b-A8f (pre-registered in docs/notes/M8.md): perturbative fast likelihood (second order off), 48 nested runs (3 data sets x 4 cells x 4 seeds), reweighted with mode (b). Gates first; a test whose posteriors fail a gate is not passed. ln Z errors: sampler part x err_inflation, plus the reweighting MC error.
